Last week we took our Tech team to the races at Down Royal Racecourse for our Summer (Autumn) party… what a day it turned out to be!
We had lots to celebrate following one of our best starts to a Financial Year ever!
lots of new client wins to celebrate, new colleagues joining the team in Belfast and Manchester and new records being set monthly.
Plans for FY 26/27 in full flight and we have lots of exciting announcements coming soon.
Watch this space ....
